Synopsis:
The London Science Museum Group Academy has ended its long-standing partnership with BP, effective 31 August, following years of activist pressure. The decision mirrors a 2024 move cutting ties with Equinor. Campaigners call it a "seismic shift" but note the museum still accepts funding from Adani Green Energy, a subsidiary of a major coal conglomerate. The article is primarily a reputational/ESG story centered on UK cultural institutions distancing themselves from fossil fuel sponsors.
